drift_correction.rationale: Generator outputs a small mean-bias in standardized space that compounds to large exponential OD drift over 777 contiguous steps; subtracting the bias isolates structural fidelity (variance / autocorrelation / oscillation amplitude) from the mean-bias-drift artifact. The fidelity metrics reported in main-text §4.2 are computed under the canonical reconstruct_od per-window random-anchor protocol and are NOT affected by this visualization-only correction.
